name: Lemon Blueberry Cream Pie
notes: A favorite of many, including a very young Levi. This pie is just the right texture with 4 Tbsp cornstarch instead of 3–discovered and revised 4/23.

steps.title: Start the filling
steps.body: Combine in saucepan: **1 cup sugar** and **4 Tbsp cornstarch**. Then add: **1 cup milk**, **3 beaten egg yolks**, **¼ cup butter** and **1 Tbsp lemon peel**.

steps.title: Cook
steps.body: Cook and stir on medium heat til thick, then two minutes more. Add **¼ cup lemon juice**.

steps.title: Chill and add
steps.body: Refrigerate til cool, then add: **1 cup sour cream** and **2 cups blueberries (fresh are better)**.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Place in a pre-baked pie crust and chill for about 4 hours. Serve with whipped cream, if desired.
